chunks: And Moses said: 'If you disbelieve, you and all those on the earth entirely, then indeed Allah is Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy.'
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God is described as Al-Ghani Al-Hamid in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Al-Ghina* as an essential attribute of God, distinct from created beings who are inherently needy (*Faqr*). It underscores that divine praise (*Al-Hamid*) is intrinsic to His nature and not contingent upon human gratitude or acknowledgment. This reinforces the theological principle that God's perfection remains absolute regardless of the universe's state of belief or disbelief.
